state.method: The Ivy Lee method: each evening, write down at most six tasks for tomorrow, most important first. Each task should be one piece of work that can be finished before starting the next.

tasks.title: Send the Q3 numbers to Priya
Ring the accountant re: tax filing

compound_0.instructions: Does the task at `plan.tasks[0].title` describe more than one distinct piece of work, each of which could be finished separately?

criteria.true: Two or more separable outcomes are joined, for example doing one thing and also deciding another.
criteria.false: One outcome, even when a single action covers several objects, such as sending a list and its attachments.

finish_0.instructions: Could an outside observer tell when the task at `plan.tasks[0].title` is finished?

criteria.true: It names a concrete outcome, deliverable or event: something sent, booked, drafted, decided, attended.
criteria.false: It is an open-ended activity with no stated end, such as working on, thinking about or looking into something.

size_0.instructions: How much focused work does the task at `plan.tasks[0].title` most plausibly need?
criteria: A few minutes: a quick message, call or booking
Under an hour of focused work
One to three hours of focused work
Most of a working day or more, or open-ended

same_0_1.instructions: Do the tasks at `plan.tasks[0].title` and `plan.tasks[1].title` describe the same piece of work, so that finishing one finishes the other?

criteria.true: The same work in different words.
criteria.false: Different work, even if it involves the same person, project or topic.
